## 2.7 GLM regression model and visualization

```{r GLM}
# to detect valuables changed with ages, here is one of the example with figure 2C
library(pscl)
library(MASS)
data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/c_means/species/si_species.txt',row.names = 1,
                   sep = '\t',stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
data <- data[1:217,]
data <- as.data.frame(apply(data,2,as.numeric))
View(data)
# Convert year to numeric (if necessary)
age <- as.numeric(data$year)

# Create a list of response variables
response_vars <- colnames(data)[2:76]

# Create an empty data frame to store the results
results <- data.frame(response_var = numeric(),
                      slope_coeff = numeric(),
                      p_value = numeric(),
                      adj_r_square = numeric(),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#family = quasipoisson(link = "log")  when not in normal distribution
# Loop over the response variables and fit a GLM for each
for (i in seq_along(response_vars)) {
  # Fit the GLM with Poisson error distribution and log link function
  model <- glm(data[, response_vars[i]] ~ age, data = data)
  # Check assumptions and extract slope coefficient and p-value for whole model
  
  #model <- glm(data[, response_vars[i]] ~ age, data = data)
 # norm_test <- shapiro.test(resid(model)) #to perform the Shapiro-Wilk normality test on a vector or a data frame column
 # print(norm_test)
  p_val <- summary(model)$coefficients[2,4]
  print(p_val)
  slope_coeff <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 1]
  adj_r_square <- with(summary(model), 1 - deviance/null.deviance)
  
  # Adjust p-value using BH method
  #adj_p_val <- p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")
  
  # Store the results in the data frame
  results[i, ] <- list(response_var = response_vars[i],
                       slope_coeff = slope_coeff,
                       p_value = p_val,
                       adj_r_square = adj_r_square)
  }

final_result <- cbind(results,padjust = p.adjust(results[,"p_value"], method="BH"))


table(final_result$padjust < 0.05)

#write.table(final_result, '/Users/chenqiong/Desktop/replot/metabo//si_species_glm.txt',sep="\t", col.names = NA,quote = FALSE)

# visualization
# mydata <- final_result
 mydata$phylum <- factor( mydata$phylum, levels = rev(mydata$phylum))
    mydata$id <- factor(mydata$id, levels = c(mydata$id))
    levels(mydata$id)
    
   
    #si
    ggdotchart(mydata, x = "id", y = "Regression_beta_coefficient",
               color = "type",                            # Color by groups
               palette = c('#14A6B1','#E3AF2E'), # Custom color palette
               sorting = "none",                # Sort value in descending order
               add = "segments",    # Add segments from y = 0 to dots
               add.params = list(size = 3),
               rotate = FALSE,                                # Rotate vertically
               group = 'id',                                # Order by groups
               dot.size = "effect", # Large dot size
               xlab="",
               ylab="Beta coefficient",
               ggtheme = theme_pubr()                        # ggplot2 theme
    ) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = 'lightgray') +
   #  coord_fixed() +
      theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
    
```

## 2.9 AEM

```{r AEM}

    library(ade4)
    library(mvpart)
    library(vegan)
    library(AEM)
    # library(PCMN)
    library(packfor)

 weight.time <- function(dates, distmat=NULL,alpha=2, beta=NULL, max.d=NULL, unit.angle="degrees", rot.angle=0, rm.same.y=TRUE,   plot.connexions=TRUE){
      #
      # dates : vector of dates.
      # alpha : exponent of the first weighting function
      # beta  : exponent of the second weighting function
      # max.d : maximum distance for weighting. Default value (not recommended in most 
      #         cases): the maximum distance among dates in the 'dates' vector. 
      #         A more meaningful solution in many applications is to compute a  
      #         Moran's I correlogram (for univariate data) or a Mantel correlogram 
      #         (for multivariate data), and use the distance where the correlation 
      #         becomes 0 as the value for max.d.
      #
      ### F. Guillaume Blanchet - August 2013
      ##########################################################################################
      n  <- length(dates)
      nb <- cell2nb(1,n)
      xy <- cbind(1:n, rep(1, n), dates)
      w  <- weight.edges(nb.object=nb, coords=xy, distmat=distmat, alpha=alpha, beta=beta, max.d=max.d, unit.angle=unit.angle, rot.angle=rot.angle, rm.same.y=rm.same.y, plot.connexions=plot.connexions)	
      w
    }
```

# Create function to identify RMSE for best lambda, 
# where x = RMSE vector, y = lambda vector, &  z = optimal lambda value
RMSE_lasso <- function(x, y, z){
  temp <- data.frame(x, y)
  colnames(temp) <- c("RMSE", "lambda_val")
  rownum <- which(temp$lambda_val==z)
  print(temp[rownum,]$RMSE)
}

# Create function to identify Rsquared for best lambda, 
# where x = Rsquared vector, y = lambda vector, &  z = optimal lambda value
Rsquared_lasso <- function(x, y, z){
  temp <- data.frame(x, y)
  colnames(temp) <- c("Rsquared", "lambda_val")
  rownum <- which(temp$lambda_val==z)
  print(temp[rownum,]$Rsquared)
}

concordance_index <- function(predictions, truth) {
  n <- length(predictions)
  n_pairs <- 0
  n_concordant <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
    for (j in (i+1):n) {
      if (truth[i] != truth[j]) {
        n_pairs <- n_pairs + 1
        if ((predictions[i] < predictions[j] && truth[i] < truth[j]) || 
            (predictions[i] > predictions[j] && truth[i] > truth[j])) {
          n_concordant <- n_concordant + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(n_concordant / n_pairs)
}


cvnested = function(data.frame, truth.frame, k){ #data.frame to train on, k is for outer fold
  print(ncol(data.frame))
  flds <- createFolds(1:ncol(data.frame), k = k, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  mse = c() # Mean Squared Error
  rmse = c() # Root Mean Squared Error
  mae = c() # Mean Absolute Error
  r_squared = c() # R-squared
  c_index = c() # Concordance Index
  predict.values.df = data.frame("carbon"=c())
  truth.values = c()
  
  for (i in 1:length(flds)){#outer
    test.outer = data.frame[, c(flds[[i]])]
    truth.test.outer = truth.frame$carbon[c(flds[[i]])]
    
    train.outer = data.frame[, -c(flds[[i]])]
    truth.train.outer = truth.frame$carbon[-c(flds[[i]])]
    
    cvglmfit = cv.glmnet(x = t(train.outer),
                         y = (truth.train.outer),
                         family = "gaussian")
    s0 = cvglmfit$lambda.1se
    
    glmfit = glmnet(x = t(train.outer),
                    y = (truth.train.outer),
                    family = "gaussian")
    
    pred = predict(glmfit, t(test.outer),
                   type = "response", s = s0)
    pred.values = predict(glmfit, t(test.outer),
                          type = "response", s = s0)
    pred.values.df = data.frame(pred.values)
    colnames(pred.values.df) = c("carbon")
    predict.values.df = rbind(predict.values.df, pred.values.df)
    
    mse = c(mse, mean((pred - truth.test.outer)^2)) # 计算 Mean Squared Error 并将其存储在 mse 向量中
    rmse = c(rmse, sqrt(mean((pred - truth.test.outer)^2))) # 计算 Root Mean Squared Error 并将其存储在 rmse 向量中
    mae = c(mae, mean(abs(pred - truth.test.outer))) # 计算 Mean Absolute Error 并将其存储在 mae 向量中
    r_squared = c(r_squared, 1 - sum((truth.test.outer - pred)^2) / sum((truth.test.outer - mean(truth.test.outer))^2)) # 计算 R-squared 并将其存储在 r_squared 向量中
    c_index = c(c_index, concordance_index(pred, truth.test.outer)) # 计算 Concordance Index 并将其存储在 c_index 向量中
  }#outer
  
  predict.values.df = predict.values.df[order(rownames(predict.values.df)),]
  
  cvglmfit.final = cv.glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                             y = (truth.frame$carbon),
                             family = "gaussian")
  s0.model = cvglmfit.final$lambda.1se
  glmfit.final = glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                        y = (truth.frame$carbon),
                        family = "gaussian")
  
  pred.all = predict(glmfit.final, t(data.frame), type = "response", s=s0.model)
  mse.all = mean((pred.all - truth.frame$carbon)^2) # 计算整个数据集的 Mean Squared Error
  rmse.all = sqrt(mean((pred.all - truth.frame$carbon)^2)) # 计算整个数据集的 Root Mean Squared Error
  mae.all = mean(abs(pred.all - truth.frame$carbon)) # 计算整个数据集的 Mean Absolute Error
  r_squared.all = 1 - sum((truth.frame$carbon - pred.all)^2) / sum((truth.frame$carbon - mean(truth.frame$carbon))^2) # 计算整个数据集的 R-squared
  c_index.all = concordance_index(pred.all, truth.frame$carbon) # 计算整个数据集的 Concordance Index
  
  print(mse.all)
  print(rmse.all)
  print(mae.all)
  print(r_squared.all)
  print(c_index.all)
  
  # 提取模型中最重要的 Top 20 个变量
  coefs = coef(glmfit.final, s = s0.model)
  coefs = coefs[-1, , drop = FALSE]  # 删除截距项
  coefs_abs = abs(coefs) # 取绝对值
  top_var_indices = order(coefs_abs, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20] # 获取 Top 20 个变量的索引
  top_var_names = rownames(coefs)[top_var_indices] # 获取 Top 20 个变量的名称
  imp_vars = coefs[top_var_indices, , drop = FALSE] # 提取最重要的 Top 20 个变量
  rownames(imp_vars) = top_var_names # 设置变量名称
  
  imp_vars_abs = coefs_abs[top_var_indices, , drop = FALSE] # 提取最重要的 Top 20 个变量的绝对值（重要性）
  rownames(imp_vars_abs) = top_var_names # 设置变量名称
  
  cat("Top 20 Important Variables and their Coefficients:\n")
  print(imp_vars)
  
  cat("Top 20 Important Variables and their Importance (Absolute Coefficients):\n")
  print(imp_vars_abs)
  
  return(list(mse = mse, rmse = rmse, mae = mae, r_squared = r_squared, c_index = c_index,
              predict.values = predict.values.df, imp_variable = as.matrix(imp_vars), imp_variable_coe = as.matrix(imp_vars_abs)))
}

#cvnest function, p is not used for glmnet predictions
# relabeled 11, 12, 14, 15yr as "spring", "summer", "fall","winter"
cvnested = function(data.frame, truth.frame, k, p){ #data.frame to train on, k is for outter fold, p is for inner fold
  print(ncol(data.frame))
  flds <- createFolds(1:ncol(data.frame), k = k, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  auc = c()
  predict.values.df = data.frame(spring=c(), summer=c(), fall=c(), winter=c())
  truth.values = c()
  #print(length(flds))
  for (i in 1:length(flds)){#outter
    test.outter = data.frame[, c(flds[[i]])]
    truth.test.outter = truth.frame$season[c(flds[[i]])]
    #print(truth.test.outter)
    #print(flds[[i]])
    train.outter = data.frame[, -c(flds[[i]])]
    truth.train.outter = truth.frame$season[-c(flds[[i]])]
    fraction = table(truth.train.outter)/length(truth.train.outter)
    weights = 1 - fraction[as.character(truth.train.outter)]
    #print(truth.train.outter)
    #print(dim(train.outter))
    #cv.glmnet takes care of inner loop training
    cvglmfit = cv.glmnet(x = t(train.outter),
                         y = factor(truth.train.outter),
                         family = "multinomial", weights = weights)
    s0 = cvglmfit$lambda.1se
    #hyper-parameter
    #fit train dataset with given hyper-parameter
    glmfit = glmnet(x = t(train.outter),
                    y = factor(truth.train.outter),
                    family = "multinomial")
    #predict on testing dataset
    pred = predict(glmfit, t(test.outter),
                   type = "class", s = s0)
    pred.values = predict(glmfit, t(test.outter),
                          type = "response", s = s0)
    pred.values.df = data.frame(pred.values)
    colnames(pred.values.df) = c("spring", "summer", "fall","winter")
    predict.values.df = rbind(predict.values.df, pred.values.df)
    
    truth.values=c(truth.values, truth.test.outter)
    confusion_table = table(predicted = pred, truth = factor(truth.test.outter))
    #print(confusion_table)
    mROC = multiclass.roc(as.numeric(factor(truth.test.outter)), as.numeric(factor(pred[,1])))
    #print(auc(mROC))
    auc = c(auc, mROC$auc)
    #test model selected by inner to the outter test set
  }#outter
  #print(dim(predict.values.df))
  #print(rownames(predict.values.df))
  #print(truth.values) #this is not necessary as the truth remains to be the truth
  #reodering the dataframe to be consistent between resamplings.
  predict.values.df = predict.values.df[order(rownames(predict.values.df)),]
  
  #fit build model on whole dataset and testing on external dataset
  fraction = table(truth.frame$season)/length(truth.frame$season)
  weights = 1 - fraction[as.character(truth.frame$season)]
  cvglmfit.final = cv.glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                             y = factor(truth.frame$season),
                             family = "multinomial", weights = weights)
  s0.model = cvglmfit.final$lambda.1se
  glmfit.final = glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                        y = factor(truth.frame$season),
                        family = "multinomial")
  #use on external dataset
  # print(paste0("the s0 used is ", s0.model))
  pred.all = predict(glmfit.final, t(data.frame), type = "class", s=s0.model)
  confusion_table.all = table(predicted = factor(pred.all, levels=c("spring", "summer", "fall","winter")), truth = factor(truth.frame$season))
  print(confusion_table.all)
  metrics = check.model.performance(factor(pred.all, levels=c("spring", "summer", "fall","winter")),factor(truth.frame$season))
  #print(metrics)
  mROC.all = multiclass.roc(as.numeric(factor(truth.frame$season)), as.numeric(factor(pred.all[,1])))
  print(mROC.all$auc)
  return(list(auc = auc, metrics=metrics, predict.values=predict.values.df))
}

# year as numeric mAUC=0.686 
check.model.performance = function(predicted.class, actual.class){
  
  result.tbl = as.data.frame(table(as.character(predicted.class),as.character(actual.class))) 
  colnames(result.tbl)[1:2] = c("Pred","Truth")
  print(result.tbl)
  control = 0  
  ##MACRO averaging here
  for (class in unique(result.tbl$Truth) ){
    control = control + 1
    print(class)
    tp = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Pred==class & result.tbl$Truth==class, "Freq"])
    tpandfp = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Pred == class , "Freq" ]) #TP plus FP
    fp = tpandfp - tp
    tpandfn = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Truth == class , "Freq" ]) #TP plus FN
    fn = tpandfn - tp
    tn = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Truth != class & result.tbl$Pred != class, "Freq"])
    print(tn)
    presi = tp/tpandfp 
    rec = tp/tpandfn
    accuracy = (tp + tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn)
    spec = tn/(tn + fp)
    F.score = 2*presi*rec/(presi+rec)
    MCC = ((tp*tn)-(fn*fp))/sqrt((tp+fn)*(tn+fp)*(tp+fp)*(tn+fn))
    if (control == 1 ) metrics = tibble(class = as.character(class), 
                                        presi = as.numeric(presi),
                                        recall = as.numeric(rec),
                                        accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
                                        spec = as.numeric(spec),
                                        F.score = as.numeric(F.score),
                                        MCC = as.numeric(MCC))
    if (control > 1 ) metrics = rbind(metrics,c(as.character(class), as.numeric(presi), as.numeric(rec), as.numeric(accuracy), as.numeric(spec), as.numeric(F.score), as.numeric(MCC)))
  }
  
  return(metrics)
}

  s0.model = cvglmfit.final$lambda.1se
  glmfit.final = glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                        y = (truth.frame$year),
                        family = "gaussian")
  #use on external dataset
  # print(paste0("the s0 used is ", s0.model))
  pred.all = predict(glmfit.final, t(data.frame), type = "response", s=s0.model)
  
  pred.all <- as.data.frame(apply(pred.all, 2, round))
  confusion_table.all = table(predicted = (pred.all[,1]), truth = (truth.frame$year))
  print(confusion_table.all)
  metrics = check.model.performance((pred.all[,1]),(truth.frame$year))
  #print(metrics)
  mROC.all = multiclass.roc((truth.frame$year), (pred.all[,1]))
  print(mROC.all$auc)
  return(list(auc = auc, metrics=metrics, predict.values=predict.values.df))
}

##multiclass auc

#use bind_cols and bind_rows for tibbles
cal_auc = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, zero_label, one_label){
  #zero_label="spring"
  #one_label="summer"
  colnames(finalvalues) = c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter")
  final.df = bind_cols(truth=finaltruth, finalvalues)
  points = tibble(label=character(), prob=double())
  for (i in 1:dim(final.df)[1]){
    if (final.df$truth[i] == zero_label | final.df$truth[i] == one_label){
      #print(as.character(final.df$truth[i]))#
      #print(as.double(final.df[i, zero_label]))
      points = bind_rows(points, tibble(label = as.character(final.df$truth[i]), prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    }
  }
  #print(dim(points))
  colnames(points) = c("label", "zero_label_prob")
  #sorted by prob values, then we get ranks
  points = points[order(points$zero_label_prob),]
  #print(points)
  #class(points)
  n0 = 0
  n1 = 0
  sum_ranks = 0
  #i is rank here
  for (i in 1:dim(points)[1]){
    if (points$label[i] == zero_label) {
      n0 = n0 + 1
      sum_ranks = sum_ranks + i
    }
    if (points$label[i] == one_label){
      n1 = n1 + 1
    }
  }
  #print(n0)
  #print(n1)
  #print(sum_ranks)
  
  return((sum_ranks - (n0*(n0+1)/2.0)) / (n0 * n1))
}

cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, "spring", "winter") 

#function generating all possible combinations from a vector, store in data.frame
combinations = function(vector){
  combos = tibble(a=character(), b=character())
  for (i in 1:(length(vector)-1)){
    for (j in (i+1):length(vector)){
      #slice = c(as.character(vector[i]), as.character(vector[j]))
      #names(slice) = c("a", "b")
      #print(vector[j])
      combos = bind_rows(combos, c(a = as.character(vector[i]), b= as.character(vector[j])))
    }
  }
  #print(combos)
  return(combos)
}

seasons = c("spring","summer", "fall", "winter")
seasons = factor(seasons, levels=c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter"))

combos = combinations(seasons)

#calculating mAUC values
#combos is the combinations between two labels
cal_mAUC = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos){
  colnames(finalvalues) = c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter")
  sums = 0
  mAUC = 0
  for (i in 1:dim(combos)[1]){
    sums = sums + (cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos$a[i], combos$b[i]) + cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos$b[i], combos$a[i]))/2
  }
  mAUC = sums * 2 / (length(seasons) * (length(seasons)-1))
  return(mAUC)
}
#this mAUC is calcualted from the pooling result of internal cv model on testing data, no external data is used
#this is a relatively conservative measurement of the model performance on the training dataset
cal_mAUC(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos)

#one vs all method
cal_roc_ova = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, zero_label){
  #zero_label="spring"
  #one_label="summer"
  colnames(finalvalues)=c("spring","summer","fall","winter")
  final.df = bind_cols(truth=finaltruth, finalvalues)
  points = data.frame(label=character(), prob=double())
  for (i in 1:dim(final.df)[1]){
    if (final.df$truth[i] == zero_label){
      #print(as.character(final.df$truth[i]))#
      #print(as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label]))
      points = rbind(points, c(label = as.character(final.df$truth[i]), prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    } else {
      points = rbind(points, c(0, prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    }}
  #print(dim(points))
  colnames(points) = c("label", "zero_label_prob")
  #sorted by prob values, then we get ranks
  points = points[order(points$zero_label_prob),]
  points$label=factor(points$label, levels =c(zero_label, 0))
  points$zero_label_prob = as.numeric(points$zero_label_prob)
  return(points)
}

selecttaxons = list(spring =c(), summer=c(), fall=c(), winter=c())

#weights calcualted by percentage of sum of absolute coefficients(weight)
weights = list(spring =c(), summer=c(), fall=c(), winter=c())

select_taxo = function(season) {
  se = season
  coefs = coef(glmfit)[[se]][, which.min(abs(glmfit$lambda - s0))]
  coefs = sort(coefs, decreasing= TRUE)
  print(se)
  #print(head(coefs,4))
  #print(tail(coefs,4))
  weights[[se]] = c(abs(coefs[coefs != 0])/sum(abs(coefs[coefs != 0]))*100)
  selecttaxons[[se]] = c(coefs[abs(coefs) >0])
  return(list(season=se, weights=weights, selecttaxo=selecttaxons[[se]]))
}
